summary: Smoke tested backend REST + SSE streaming (gpt-5.6-terra & claude-sonnet-5) and frontend UI (empty state, model selector, chat send/stream, sidebar, imagine toggle, prompt suggestions). All flows work EXCEPT /api/image/generate which returns HTTP 500 due to a serialization bug (asst_doc is mutated by MongoDB insert_one to include ObjectId _id, then returned directly, causing FastAPI jsonable_encoder to fail). This blocks the Imagine feature end-to-end even though the image is actually created in Mongo.
passed: GET /api/models returns all 4 models with correct provider/support flags
POST /api/conversations creates conversation; GET /api/conversations lists sorted by updated_at desc
PATCH /api/conversations/{id} renames; DELETE /api/conversations/{id} deletes conv and its messages (verified GET messages returns [])
POST /api/chat/stream (gpt-5.6-terra): streams 'data: {"type":"delta"...}' lines followed by a 'done' event; user+assistant messages persisted
POST /api/chat/stream (claude-sonnet-5): multi-provider streaming works; emits 'title' auto-title event
Auto-title: New chat conversation title updated to first user message (verified via GET /api/conversations)
Multi-turn history: sent 'My name is Rex' then 'What is my name?' — assistant reply contains 'Rex' (context retained)
Frontend empty state: 'Welcome to KILASphere' hero, GPT 5.6 Terra default label, NEW CHAT + HISTORY visible
Model selector: menu opens with 4 options; switching to Gemini 3.1 Pro updates label
Chat send flow: typing in chat-input + send-btn streams response and creates a new sidebar conv-item
Imagine toggle: placeholder changes to 'Describe an image to generate...'
Prompt suggestions visible in empty state (prompt-suggestion-0)

failed.issue: POST /api/image/generate returns HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error'. Traceback: ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"), TypeError('vars() argument must have __dict__ attribute')] from fastapi.encoders.jsonable_encoder. Root cause: after `await db.messages.insert_one(asst_doc)` on line 374 of server.py, Motor mutates asst_doc to add a MongoDB `_id` ObjectId. The endpoint then does `return {"message": asst_doc}` (line 387) which sends the ObjectId to jsonable_encoder and fails.
failed.evidence: curl -X POST /api/image/generate -> HTTP/2 500, body 'Internal Server Error'. Backend log shows the traceback ending in ValueError above. The image is actually generated and stored in Mongo before the crash.

action_items: Fix /api/image/generate serialization: either strip `_id` from asst_doc before returning (e.g. `asst_doc.pop('_id', None)`) or return a fresh dict of only the desired fields. Same defensive pattern should be considered anywhere `insert_one(doc)` is followed by returning `doc`.
Retest /api/image/generate after fix and verify frontend Imagine flow renders the image inline (image_data_url starts with 'data:image/').

not_tested: /api/voice/transcribe (skipped per instructions; mic gesture blocked in headless)
